cumleler: Hearing aid sounds weak: should you turn up the gain?
With a weak sound complaint, do not rush to add gain.
First check the battery; a weak battery hides behind many faults.
The most common cause is a wax guard partly blocked by earwax.
Also check the dome, tubing, and the ear canal with otoscopy.
Raise gain instead, and a new filter makes the aid too loud.
